decisions.reason: The required row insertion and field-copying workflow does not change which Board Meeting fields must align or the identification of Topic as tema.
The source specifies a Board Meeting row workflow and does not change column wrapping or page-margin containment behavior.
Copying fields before entering content in an inserted Board Meeting row does not alter the multiline-entry behavior required in the Board Seminar context.
The row insertion workflow does not modify the fixed-margin behavior of the Vejledning short-description section.
The source decision concerns copying fields in an inserted table row and does not change bullet appearance or list formatting.
The source does not change hard-return spacing in continuous text or its applicable contexts.
The instruction to copy fields before writing does not change the date selector's input method, display format, or scope.
Although the workflow mentions copying fields, it does not state that clear-on-activation behavior or its scope changes for those fields.
The source defines the Board Meeting row workflow but does not change the separate task-local obligation to explain how Master template tables function.
The Board Meeting row workflow has no effect on the approved theme colors or available color choices.
Copying fields within an inserted row is distinct from pasting legacy content and does not change post-paste line-break behavior.
The requirement to copy fields before writing does not change their help-label language, text, hover behavior, locations, or applicability.
